# Export your transformations

In this milestone, you'll learn how to export your transformations outside Grafana Cloud. 

By default, Grafana Cloud does not support exporting data transformations directly to an external database or other tools. However, you can export the transformation manually as a CSV file.

To export the data transformations, complete the following steps:

1. Open your dashboard in edit mode.
1. Click **Queries** tab and click **Query Inspector** button.
1. Select the **Data** tab.
1. Expand the **> Data options** row.
1. Enable the **Apply panel transformation** option.

    The following image shows the browser market share table with the filter data by values transformation applied.

    ![Browser market share with transformations applied](/media/docs/learning-journey/data-transformations/export-transformations.png)

1. Click **Download CSV** button.

  A CSV file will be generated containing the data set with transformations.
